title: Plate
simplified_paragraphs: 有一天，妈妈和女儿一起洗盘子，爸爸和儿子一起看电视。突然，他们听见打破盘子的声音。儿子看着他父亲，说：“一定是妈妈打破的。”爸爸问：“你怎么知道？”儿子回答:“昨天，我打破了一个盘子，妈妈很不高兴。但是今天妈妈没有骂人。”
traditional_paragraphs: 有一天，媽媽和女兒一起洗盤子，爸爸和兒子一起看電視。突然，他們聽見打破盤子的聲音。兒子看著他父親，說：“一定是媽媽打破的。”爸爸問：“你怎麼知道？”兒子回答:“昨天，我打破了一個盤子，媽媽很不高興。但是今天媽媽沒有罵人。”
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yì tiān， mā ma hé nǚ ér yī qǐ xǐ pán zi， bà ba hé ér zi yī qǐ kàn diàn shì。 tū rán， tā men tīng jiàn dǎ pò pán zi de shēng yīn。 ér zi kàn zhe tā fù qīn， shuō：“ yī dìng shì mā ma dǎ pò de。” bà ba wèn：“ nǐ zěn me zhī dào？” ér zi huí dá :“ zuó tiān， wǒ dǎ pò le yī gè pán zi， mā ma hěn bù gāo xìng。 dàn shì jīn tiān mā ma méi yǒu mà rén。”
english_paragraphs: One day, a mother and her daughter were washing the dishes while the father and son watched TV. Suddenly, they heard a plate break. The son looked at his father and said, “Mom must have broken it.” “How do you know?” his father asked. The son replied, “Yesterday, I broke a plate, and Mom was very upset. But today, she hasn’t scolded anyone.”
english_full: One day, a mother and her daughter were washing the dishes while the father and son watched TV. Suddenly, they heard a plate break. But today, she hasn’t scolded anyone.”
